author: smcarus
title: Will Mexico's unemployment rate be lower in 2026 than in 2025?
summary: Give the probability that the IMF WEO unemployment rate for Mexico is lower for 2026 than for 2025, both as first read on or after 1 May 2027 (after the April 2027 WEO).
knownLimits: The 2026 figure in the April 2027 WEO is still an IMF estimate and may be revised later; the first reading stands.
Many people in Mexico work informally; the unemployment rate does not show how many are in poor-quality jobs.
